definitions.explanation: A written piece, typically for school assignments.

examples.japanese: {日本語|にほんご}で{作文|さくぶん}を{書|か}きました。
examples.english: I wrote an essay in Japanese.

examples.japanese: {作文|さくぶん}の{宿題|しゅくだい}があります。
examples.english: I have an essay homework assignment.

examples.japanese: {夏休|なつやす}みの{思|おも}い{出|で}について{作文|さくぶん}する。
examples.english: To write an essay about summer vacation memories.

notes:
{作文|さくぶん} refers to written compositions, often for school.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {作文|さくぶん}を{書|か}く (to write an essay)
- {作文|さくぶん}する (to compose, write)
- {作文|さくぶん}{用紙|ようし} (essay paper)

RELATED:
- {文章|ぶんしょう} (sentence, text)
- {論文|ろんぶん} (thesis, academic paper)
- {小論文|しょうろんぶん} (short essay)
